  • 日本語名: 黒髪清楚ちゃん物語 ―彼氏じゃない人でイキ狂ってえっち大好きになってしまう女子校生―
  • 英語名: Kurokami Seiso-chan Monogatari -Kareshi ja Nai Hito de Iki Kurutte Ecchi Daisuki ni Natte Shimau Joshikousei-

あらすじ

The protagonist, Kurokami seiso-chan (Ayame) is a high school student who aims to attend a national university together with her boyfriend.

One day, Ayame happens upon her classmate having sex with his sex friend, and thought “Is sex really different with other people?”. He then said “If you’re curious, then won’t you try doing it with me?”. She refused the invitation at first, but as she remembered the two having sex so differently than the way she has sex with her boyfriend, she can’t help but get curious.

item.title: Revenge Porn
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Atelier Sakura eXtra
  • 発売日: 2015-08-28
  • スコア: 6.25/10 (40 人評価)
  • 日本語名: リベンジポルノ
  • 英語名: Revenge Porn

あらすじ

Misaki Yuuji has been married for several years. He is happy with his life, and so is his wife, Ayaka, who is also happy to be by her beloved husband’s side, and is content with their happy life.

Then one day, they receive an email. It was sent by Ayaka’s old boyfriend, Ookura Tetsuya. He can’t forgive her for shaking him off and building a happy family, so he pressures her to get back together. Yuuji finds out about the situation, but he doesn’t feel threatened and consoles Ayaka, advising her to leave him alone.
